conviction_note: The print is subordinate to a signed, board-recommended $16.25/ADS all-cash tender from the 67% holder (commenced 2026-11-10, expires 2026-12-10); spot 15.715 sits 3.4% below it, so the stock trades as merger arbitrage and the earnings line can only nudge perceived completion risk. abs_move 1.5 (deal-pinned name; the two confirmed 2026 prints moved +2.16 and -0.97 before any agreement was signed), p_up 52 for spread drift and a recommended deal, giving +0.06. The findings sum to -0.2 because the two deal-risk items (activist holdouts against a 90-95% minimum tender, and a likely revenue shortfall against consensus that management's own projections imply) lean slightly negative, while drift leans positive. The gap is small and both numbers are close to zero, which is the honest answer.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus $0.60 EPADS / $92.9m revenue, one source: Earnings Whispers preview (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/DDI/2610283951, also via https://finviz.com/news/417335/doubledowns-margin-story-faces-a-buyout-price-test-as-revenue-is-expected-to-slip, dated 2026-11-05). No company guidance. One source, so every finding is capped small. The company's own Management Projections in the SC 14D9 (2026E net revenue $354.7m, delivered 2026-08-24) imply H2 2026 revenue of about $166.3m after H1's $188.4m ($94.1m Q1 + $94.3m Q2), about $83m a quarter, roughly 10% below the $92.9m bar. That is a projection prepared for a take-private and described as conservative by the special committee, not guidance.
positioning_check: Short interest is negligible: 9,532 shares on 2026-07-15, 0.2 days to cover (MarketBeat, https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/doubledown-interactive-co-ltd-sponsored-adr-nasdaqddi-short-interest-down-365-in-july-2026-07-30/). No later settlement figure found. No options market (baseline options.status no_options_market), so there is no skew. The positioning that matters is merger arbitrage: a definitive $16.25 all-cash tender, spot 15.715 (3.4% gross spread with about 29 days to the scheduled 2026-12-10 expiry). The run-up of +14.2% over 5 days and +15.1% over 20 days is the 2026-11-09 deal announcement (19x median volume that day), not a pre-print rally. A 13G/A was filed 2026-11-06; holder not identified.

findings.finding: On 2026-11-09 DoubleU Games (67.05% holder) signed a definitive agreement for an all-cash tender at US$16.25 per ADS, unanimously recommended by the special committee and the board. The tender commenced 2026-11-10 and expires 2026-12-10. There is no financing condition (cash on hand plus a KRW 300bn committed bridge), and DUG called $16.25 its 'best and final'. Against spot 15.715 the gross spread is 3.4%, so the Q3 print can only move the stock through perceived completion risk, and the stock should drift toward the offer.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Deal announcement day 2026-11-09: +15.6% on 1.9m shares against a 100k median (baseline session_conflict block). The only two confirmed 2026 earnings releases, 2026-05-12 (+2.16) and 2026-08-11 (-0.97), came while only a non-binding $11.25 proposal existed. No earnings print has happened under a signed agreement.
findings.why_not_priced: The deal itself is fully priced; what is not in the price is a reason for the print to matter. If the market expected the Q3 release to reprice the company, the stock would trade with a wider or more volatile spread. Instead it sits 3.4% below a firm cash price, which caps the reaction both ways. The positive sign is only the arb drift plus the recommended deal.
findings.independence: SC TO-T offer to purchase, expiry 5:00 pm NYC 2026-12-10, no financing condition (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001799567/000119312526455784/d469729dsctot.htm). SC 14D9 board recommendation to ACCEPT (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001799567/000119312526455755/d153031dsc14d9.htm). Both are deal documents from the same transaction.

findings.finding: The Management Projections disclosed in the SC 14D9 put 2026E net revenue at $354.7m, falling to $308.3m in 2027E and $246.3m in 2028E, on an expected migration of players off a third-party platform. After H1 2026 revenue of $188.4m ($94.1m + $94.3m), that implies about $166.3m for H2, roughly $83m a quarter, against the $92.9m Q3 consensus. In a deal-pinned stock a miss cuts both ways: it weakens the holdouts' case and makes the tender more likely to succeed (up), and it lowers the standalone value if the deal fails (down). Net near zero, slightly negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 revenue $94.1m (+12.7% y/y) moved +2.16 on 2026-05-12, and Q2 2026 revenue $94.3m (+11.2% y/y) moved -0.97 on 2026-08-11. Both came under a non-binding proposal, not a signed tender. There is no history of a revenue miss under a signed deal.
findings.why_not_priced: The $92.9m consensus is dated 2026-11-05, before the SC 14D9 published the projections on 2026-11-10, so the bar may be stale. If the market had absorbed the projections, previews would anchor near $83-88m. They do not, though in a merger-arb name few people trade on that bar. The special committee called the projections conservative, and the platform-migration hit may fall mostly after Q3, so the implied Q3 shortfall is an inference, not a number the company has reported.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 release shows revenue flat sequentially at $94.3m, with no guidance and DTC at 52.4% of social casino revenue (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1799567/000162828026055705/ddi-2026x08x11x6kxexx991.htm). That points to no growth, not to a decline. An AI summary page mentions a purported IGT license termination as the likely platform risk (https://www.panabee.com/news/doubledown-interactive-earnings-q1-2026); this is weak and unverified.

findings.finding: Completion is not assured, and the print plus the call are the first public data a holdout can use. The minimum tender condition is 95% of all common shares, reducible only to a 90% floor with company consent, so about 70% of the 32.95% unaffiliated stake must tender. There is also a non-waivable majority-of-the-minority condition, and no tender or support agreements exist. Four Tree Island Advisory (a self-described top-10/15 holder) has argued DDI is worth at least $26.40/ADS, and Stonehill (about 1.0m ADSs) opposed the earlier proposal. Kroll's preliminary ranges ran to $20-25 on consensus estimates and trading multiples. A strong Q3 would arm holdouts and widen the spread; a weak one would do the opposite.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance under a signed agreement. Four Tree Island's May and August 2026 letters came while the stock traded above the $11.25 proposal, and it was at $13.76 on 2026-11-05.
findings.why_not_priced: A 3.4% spread with 29 days to expiry annualises to about 40%. That is wide for a no-financing-condition deal by a controlling holder, so completion risk is partly priced already. What is not priced is any new holdout statement against $16.25: none was found after 2026-11-09. If one lands with the print it would show as a widening spread.
findings.independence: Four Tree Island release of 2026-05-04 (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/04/3287088/0/en/Four-Tree-Island-Advisory-Urges-Special-Committee-of-DoubleDown-Interactive-to-Reject-Controlling-Shareholder-DoubleU-Games-Inadequate-Takeover-Proposal.html). The $26.40 view is from a later letter cited via https://www.webull.com/news/15420003522003968. Minimum tender terms are also in the SC TO-T (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001799567/000119312526455784/d469729dsctot.htm).

findings.finding: The transaction agreement bars DDI from declaring any dividend or distribution without DUG's consent, so the Q3 release cannot carry a capital-return surprise despite about $553.8m of cash and short-term investments at 2026-06-30 (about $11.2 per ADS on 49.55m ADS equivalents).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None; DDI has paid no regular dividend under this structure.
findings.why_not_priced: It is fully priced. It is filed only so the panel knows the release cannot contain a buyback or special dividend.
findings.independence: Same transaction agreement as the first finding. Cash figure from the SC 14D9 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001799567/000119312526455755/d153031dsc14d9.htm).

outside_window.finding: Tender offer outcome: whether the 90-95% minimum and the majority-of-the-minority condition are met by the scheduled 2026-12-10 expiry (extendable to the 2027-03-10 End Date). This is the real binary for the stock: about +3.4% if it completes; if it fails, a fall toward a standalone value somewhere below the pre-deal $13.76.

Party A, an unnamed strategic buyer, proposed $15.00 and indicated $17.00/ADS on 2026-10-01, conditional on diligence it was never granted. A renewed public topping bid would lift the stock above $16.25, but nothing dated suggests one lands in the window.
